<p class="home-intro">Pick the group closest to what you're doing; each tool has a line on what it's for. Not sure where to start? The <a href="/index.html">home page</a> starts from the task.</p>

<div class="home-tasks">

<section class="home-task">
  <h2>Play with a band</h2>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="/tools/backing-track.html">Backing Track</a> — type or paste chords, pick a style, and a full band plays them.</li>
    <li><a href="/styles/index.html">Style Notes</a> — what each groove does, swing to reggaeton, before you choose one.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/accomp-styles.html">Accompaniment Styles</a> — named comping rhythms, from the Charleston on, each described and played.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/drumset.html">Drumset</a> — build a drum groove piece by piece and play it.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/sequencers.html">Sequencers & Arpeggiators</a> — every kind of step sequencer and arpeggiator on one clock.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/arranger.html">Style Arranger</a> — an arranger keyboard: hold a chord and an eight-part band follows it through intro, four mains, fills, break and ending.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/polyrhythm.html">Polyrhythm</a> — two to four rhythms at once, as polyrhythm or polymeter, on a circle and a grid.</li>
  </ul>
</section>

<section class="home-task">
  <h2>Chords and harmony</h2>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="/tools/chord-library.html">Chord Library</a> — every shape, with the lessons that teach it.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/chord-sheet.html">Chord Sheet</a> — type chords and get diagrams for your instruments, with notation and playback.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/chord-entry.html">Chord Entry</a> — play chords on a MIDI keyboard and get a chart for the band.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/chords-solfege.html">Chords and Solfège</a> — play notes and see the chord, its Roman numeral, and each note in solfège, degrees or Sargam.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/circle-of-fifths.html">Circle of Fifths</a> — keys, signatures and related chords on one wheel.</li>
  </ul>
</section>

<section class="home-task">
  <h2>Scales and reading</h2>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="/tools/scales.html">Scales</a> — any scale in any key, drawn and played.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/scale-patterns.html">Scale Patterns</a> — scale exercises written out for any key, style and instrument, Hanon included.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/part-reader.html">Part Reader</a> — what a transposing part's key and notes are in concert pitch.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/classical-themes.html">Classical Themes</a> — 2,067 themes from the repertoire to read and hear.</li>
  </ul>
</section>

<section class="home-task">
  <h2>Write music down</h2>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="/tools/notation.html">Notation</a> — play or type a melody; add chords and words, then hear it.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/notation-rules.html">Notation Rules</a> — how the entry pages decide what to write from the keys you play.</li>
  </ul>
</section>

<section class="home-task">
  <h2>Learn from a recording</h2>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="/tools/timestamp-notes.html">Timestamp Notes</a> — stamp the sections, tap the bars, loop phrase by phrase.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/tap-along.html">Tap Along</a> — the same mapping on a phone while the song plays.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/tap-latency.html">Tap Latency</a> — how late your taps land, so Tap Along can allow for it.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/chunk-practice.html">Chunk Practice</a> — break a fast passage into chunks and build it up to speed.</li>
  </ul>
</section>

<section class="home-task">
  <h2>Voice</h2>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="/tools/vocal-warmup.html">Vocal Warm-up</a> — a routine built for your voice and your time.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/ipa-chart.html">IPA Chart for Singers</a> — the sounds of sung vowels and consonants.</li>
  </ul>
</section>

<section class="home-task">
  <h2>Guitar and bass</h2>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="/tools/guitar-tuning.html">Guitar Tuning</a> — tune by ear six ways, any tuning, with the mic as a check.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/guitar-setup-check.html">Setup Check</a> — buzz, action, relief, intonation: what to adjust, and who should.</li>
    <li><a href="/tools/guitar-in.html">Guitar Input Check</a> — play a note or chord and the page says whether it heard what it asked for.</li>
  </ul>
</section>

</div>
